tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and app background (MudBlazor Background). Light: harbor fog. Dark: night water.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, drawer, landing sections (MudBlazor Surface, DrawerBackground).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: code blocks, table header rows, input fills, skeleton base.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, popovers. In dark, height is shown by a lighter surface, not by shadow alone.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltips and chart tooltips. Text on it: ink-inverse.

tokens.name: appbar
tokens.usage: Portal app bar and landing top bar. Text: appbar-ink. Focus here: focus-on-inverse.

tokens.name: appbar-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on appbar (15.6:1 light, 15.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and table lines. Decorative only, never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders, chart quota line. 3.6:1 on surface (light), 3.8:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-sunken, surface-raised (>=13:1 both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, axis labels, metadata on every surface (>=6.2:1 light, >=7.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse (tooltips).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled text and icons only (WCAG exempts disabled controls). Never for readable content.

tokens.name: harbor-navy
tokens.usage: The brand ink. App-icon tile, logo on light grounds. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Portal primary actions, links, selected nav, active tab. As text on every surface (>=6.2:1 light, >=7:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (7.2:1 light, 8.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, active nav item background. Text on it: primary or ink.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Harbor light. Landing CTA fill, logo container, highlights. Never a status, never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (9:1 light, 11:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-edge
tokens.usage: 1px border on accent fills so the button edge reads on white (4.2:1).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as text: eyebrows, small highlights (6.2:1 on surface light, 10.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on bg, surface, sunken and raised (>=6.2:1 light, >=7:1 dark). Same as MudBlazor Primary, so portal and site match.

tokens.name: focus-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Focus ring on appbar and surface-inverse (10:1).

tokens.name: navlight-port
tokens.usage: Decorative red port light. Landing dividers and hero only. Never near status UI.

tokens.name: navlight-starboard
tokens.usage: Decorative green starboard light. Pairs with navlight-port. Never near status UI.

tokens.name: illus-line
tokens.usage: Illustration strokes. Same in both themes (4.6:1 on white, 3.8:1 on dark surface).

tokens.name: illus-water
tokens.usage: Illustration water lines and secondary strokes.

tokens.name: illus-light
tokens.usage: Illustration highlight: harbor lights, the docked container, dawn sun.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success / healthy. As text or icon on every surface (>=5:1). Always with icon + label.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background for success badges, alerts and banners. Text on it: success (>=5.1:1).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning / degraded. An orange, kept apart from the gold accent by lightness (light) and hue (dark). As text or icon on every surface (>=5:1). Always with icon + label.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background for warning badges, alerts and banners. Text on it: warning (>=5.1:1).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error / unreachable. As text or icon on every surface (>=5:1). Always with icon + label.

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Background for error badges, alerts and banners. Text on it: error (>=5.1:1).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info notices. As text or icon on every surface (>=5:1). Always with icon + label.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background for info badges, alerts and banners. Text on it: info (>=5.1:1).

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Neutral state / draining. Planned, not a problem. As text or icon on every surface (>=5:1). Always with icon + label.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Background for neutral badges, alerts and banners. Text on it: neutral (>=5.1:1).

tokens.name: state-healthy
tokens.usage: Module state healthy. Always with icon circle-check and the word 'healthy'.

tokens.name: state-degraded
tokens.usage: Module state degraded. Always with icon triangle-alert and the word 'degraded'.

tokens.name: state-unreachable
tokens.usage: Module state unreachable. Always with icon circle-x and the word 'unreachable'.

tokens.name: state-draining
tokens.usage: Module state draining. Always with icon arrow-down-to-line and the word 'draining'.

tokens.name: viz-1
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 1 (blue). Assign in fixed order, by entity, never by rank.

tokens.name: viz-2
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 2 (orange). Assign in fixed order, by entity, never by rank.

tokens.name: viz-3
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 3 (aqua). Assign in fixed order, by entity, never by rank. Below 3:1 on light: needs direct labels or table.

tokens.name: viz-4
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 4 (yellow). Assign in fixed order, by entity, never by rank. Below 3:1 on light: needs direct labels or table.

tokens.name: viz-5
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 5 (magenta). Assign in fixed order, by entity, never by rank. Below 3:1 on light: needs direct labels or table.

tokens.name: viz-6
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 6 (green). Assign in fixed order, by entity, never by rank.

tokens.name: viz-7
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 7 (violet). Assign in fixed order, by entity, never by rank.

tokens.name: viz-8
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 8 (red). Assign in fixed order, by entity, never by rank.

tokens.name: seq-100
tokens.usage: Sequential usage intensity (heatmaps). 100 = near zero, 700 = peak. Dark theme reverses so low values recede into the night.

tokens.name: seq-200
tokens.usage: Sequential usage intensity (heatmaps). 100 = near zero, 700 = peak. Dark theme reverses so low values recede into the night.

tokens.name: seq-600

tokens.name: viz-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines, 1px, horizontal only.

tokens.name: viz-axis
tokens.usage: Chart baseline / x-axis, 1px.

tokens.name: viz-empty
tokens.usage: Empty plot area fill and skeleton bars.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Landing hero claim only. 36px/40px below 600px width.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Landing sub-sections; portal page title on wide screens.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Portal page title (MudBlazor H4/H5 map here).

styles.name: h5
styles.usage: Panel titles, pillar titles on mobile.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Deep business modules – self-hosted, multi-tenant, open source.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Portal default text, tables, forms (MudBlazor Body2).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, nav items. Sentence case, no uppercase.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Helper text, chart legends, badge text.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Landing eyebrows in accent-ink; uppercase via CSS only.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Inline code, IDs, API keys, client IDs.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Numbers in tables and chart tooltips. Right-aligned. Mono is tabular by design.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Stat tile value. Sans with tabular-nums.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding, table cell padding (y).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (portal), table cell padding (x), mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Form field gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (landing), grid gap.

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-16

tokens.name: space-24

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chart bar ends, focus-ring corners on tight items.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, inputs, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, menus. MudBlazor DefaultBorderRadius.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Landing cards, dialogs, code panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, status dots, toggle tracks.

shadow.note: Calm, low shadows. In dark, pair every shadow with a lighter surface (surface-raised).

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Cards resting on bg.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, sticky app bar.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the secret-once dialog.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, card borders, inputs.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Selected card, focus ring width.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between element and focus ring.

duration.note: Motion is short and functional. Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, every duration becomes 0ms except loading spinners (slowed, not removed).

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, toggles.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menus, drawer, tabs.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Dialogs, landing reveal of the docking container.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Most transitions: settle into place, like a ship easing into a berth.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Elements leaving the screen.
